messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm drafting the canary config for model-v2 rollout on /generate. Thinking microstep ramp with tight guards. want feedback before I land it.

alex: SGTM. what do you mean by microstep? percent steps or continuous?

maria: percent steps. proposed: [1, 3, 10, 30, 60, 100]. each step = 10m by default, with a 5m observation window. auto-abort if error_rate > 1.0% or p95 latency regresses > 25% vs baseline.

sam: can you paste the config snippet so I can run it through the simulator? would prefer a holdpoint after 10% for manual review.

maria: sure — here's a rough draft:```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "from_model": "model-v1",
  "to_model": "model-v2",
  "steps": [1,3,10,30,60,100],
  "step_duration_minutes": 10,
  "observation_window_minutes": 5,
  "guards": {
    "error_rate_pct": 1.0,
    "p95_latency_regress_pct": 25,
    "server_error_threshold": 5
  },
  "holdpoints": [10],
  "fallback": {
    "type": "immediate",
    "reason_tags": ["guard_violation"]
  },
  "telemetry_hooks": ["per-step-snapshot","cohort-trace-sample:10%"],
  "cohort_policy": "random-slice",
  "canary_label": "v2-microstep"
}
```

tanya: UX note — console should show cohort sizes in realtime and a big red abort button. also show which telemetry hook last fired. small thing: allow holdpoint to be manual or auto (I prefer manual at 10%).

maria: added manual holdpoint option in the draft. also toggled `cohort_tracing` to 10% sample by default.

ryan: what about Dedicated customers pinned to older models? routing policy needs to exclude pinned tenants from the slice. otherwise we violate isolation.

maria: good catch. plan: routing rule precedence — customer pin > route-level canary. will add an explicit `exclude_pinned_customers: true` flag.

alex: how does this interact with quotas and rate limiting? if we drop traffic to v1 and a lot of users hit v2 it might spike cost.

maria: rollout is ratio based (traffic split). we keep overall QPS same; model selection happens before quota calculation. quotas apply per-customer and per-route; we'll instrument to surface estimated token burn per-step in the console.

sam: can we add a soft-backoff if we see infra-side queue growth? say, add a 2x step-duration increase if in-flight queue > 75% for >3min.

maria: added `backoff_policy: {threshold_percent:75, sustained_minutes:3, multiplier:2}` to the draft.

deploy-bot: rollout draft created by maria — id `rl-2280012345`, visibility: eng-platform, requires approval at holdpoints. :robot_face:

alex: telemetry — make sure p50/p95/p99 are captured and we log sample traces for failed requests. also attach per-step diff vs baseline for model quality metrics (bleu/rouge/whatever for batch evals).

maria: yes. telemetry_hooks include metric diffs, sample traces, and eval-set regression checks at each step. we'll post summaries to #console-rollouts channel and hook to the alerts pipeline.

tanya: console UX: show an inline timeline with steps, state (pending/active/paused/aborted), and a quick-reason field on abort. also allow rollback-to-last-stable button.

ryan: enterprise note — need an audit log for all rollouts and manual approvals for compliance. include identity and timestamp for approvals.

maria: agreed — audit log + signed approvals included.

alex: final q — do we want tiny initial step (0.1% or 0.5%) for high-risk models?

maria: we discussed 1% as min, but we can support fractional percent if the routing layer supports weighted hashing. I'll add `min_step_fractional: true` as an opt-in flag.

sam: can you add an example of a `abort_reason` payload so alerting can route properly?

maria: added `abort_reason` enums: ["error_rate","latency_regress","infra_backpressure","manual","quality_regress"]. we'll send these with webhook/alert events.

maria: next steps: I'll update the PR with the changes (exclude_pinned_customers, backoff_policy, manual holdpoint, min_fractional flag), add simulator tests, and mock console screenshots for Tanya. planning to land tomorrow if no objections.

alex: +1

sam: +1. I'll run simulator once PR is up.

tanya: +1 on screenshots.

ryan: approve from compliance side for audit schema.

maria: thanks — I'll ping when PR is ready.
